bounded_statement: The report's selected result (pooled two-sample t-test of anet_umol_m2_s by salinity_regime, t(94) = 5.99, p < 0.0001, rejecting equality at the 5% level) is not supported at the declared independent unit. The data description names seedling_id as the independent unit (12 seedlings, 8 leaf readings each; treatment applied to whole pots), yet the workflow feeds all 96 leaf rows into scipy.stats.ttest_ind as independent observations. Aggregating to one mean per seedling (ambient: 11.50, 12.10, 12.50, 12.80, 13.40, 13.90; elevated: 10.60, 10.90, 11.40, 12.10, 12.40, 12.80) preserves the 1.000 umol CO2 m^-2 s^-1 mean difference but yields pooled t(10) = 1.99, below the two-sided 5% critical value 2.228 (p = 0.075). The claimed significance is an artifact of counting 8 correlated within-seedling readings as independent, inflating degrees of freedom from 10 to 94.

counterevidence_considered.description: The workflow is aware of the unit column: it defines UNIT_COLUMN = 'seedling_id' and correctly reports the design (12 seedlings, 8 readings per seedling, 6 per regime) in the report narrative. However, this awareness is used only for descriptive text, not for the statistical test, so it does not negate the issue.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: UNIT_COLUMN defined and design correctly described, but unused in inference

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to show the conclusion survives a unit-correct reanalysis. Computing per-seedling means from data/input.csv by hand: ambient (MG01-MG06) = 11.50, 12.10, 12.50, 12.80, 13.40, 13.90 (mean 12.70, sum of squared deviations 3.78); elevated (MG07-MG12) = 10.60, 10.90, 11.40, 12.10, 12.40, 12.80 (mean 11.70, sum of squared deviations 3.80). Pooled variance = (3.78+3.80)/10 = 0.758; SE of the difference = sqrt(0.758 x (1/6+1/6)) = 0.5027; t = 1.000/0.5027 = 1.99 on 10 df, below the two-sided 5% critical value of 2.228 (p = 0.075), so equality is not rejected. I also verified the report's own leaf-level numbers are internally consistent (means 12.700/11.700, SDs 0.816/0.818 imply t = 6.0 on 94 df, matching t(94) = 5.99), confirming the discrepancy stems solely from treating 96 correlated rows as independent, not from a computational error. The falsification failed: the reported significance does not survive analysis at the declared independent unit.

root_cause: values_by_regime() appends one value per CSV row into per-regime lists and passes them directly to stats.ttest_ind(equal_var=True), which assumes each element is independent. Although the script defines UNIT_COLUMN = "seedling_id" and counts seedlings in seedlings_by_regime(), that grouping is used only for narrative text, never in inference. Each seedling therefore contributes 8 repeated entries to a row-independent procedure, producing 48 pseudo-observations per regime, 94 df instead of 10, and a p-value (< 0.0001) that overstates the evidence; the correct seedling-level test does not reject at the 5% level (p = 0.075).
